notes.title: More Twitch Integration!
notes.notes:
Long live Taxien! We have heard your wishes and implemented the following for you.

[h1]MORE TWITCH INTEGRATION[/h1]

[b]o Polls in tax decision[/b]
Chat can now help you decide, but not take over for you. You decide for yourself, but you can see how your viewership would decide. In the options you can also turn off this poll option. As soon as you are at the selection, in the chat automatically comes - in your name (of the streamer) - a message, how to vote.

[b]o book page for all commands[/b]
For all commands you can use with the twitch integration, there is now also an extra book page for a better overview.

[b]o Dropdown menu for selection of users who can use commands[/b].
You can now select who is allowed to use the commands. You can choose between: Moderators, Moderators & Vips or Mods & Vips & Subs.

notes.title: Quality of Life - Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello you busy package bees!

We have a few renewals, additions and improvements for you.

[b]Big packages are smaller[/b].
Some players had the problem with very large packages that they could no longer reach the tools underneath the package or accidentally had a tool in their hand while turning. This should be fixed by "smaller" large packages now.

[b]Warning stickers are explained in more detail[/b].
Warning stickers now have their own tab as soon as they become relevant. Here all objects are listed again, which are to be connected with the appropriate sticker. 

[b]New Mode: Relaxed Work (more time)[/b]
We have noticed that many players do not get along with the mode "With time pressure", the further you progress in the game. Here we decided to make a more relaxed, but still with time limit, mode. You have about 60 seconds per package here.

Also, you can reselect the difficulty level on gameover if it was too hard or too easy for you after all.

[b]Rotate packages with tool possible[/b]
Often requested and now possible: as soon as you have the tape or the black light in your hand, you can still rotate the package!

[b]Logic error for import and export fixed[/b]
Foreign mail is from now on no longer affected by the domestic rule (rule: 3kg food maximum)

[b]Twitchintegration[/b]
Your mods can now help you clean your book again. Or you can just drink less Fritz Kola ;D
!cleanup - clean up the book

notes.title: Fixes + Resolution-Issue
notes.notes:
In todays patch we concentrated on fixing currently reported bugs, to give you, the players, the best playing experience as soon as possible.
Hope you have a great day!

[b]Long live Taxien![/b]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Issue while loading the settings
[*] Issue of still overlapping settings menues
[*] Issue on resolution change
[*] Changed save state sorting (this should be more consistent on new savestates)
[*] Extended resolution options with monitor frequency
[/list]

By adding the frequency to the resolution dropdown, we hope to fix the "resolution can't be changed" issue, some people are experiencing.

notes.title: Extended Twitch integration + Quality of life
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Clearer game loading screen
[*] Notification on save
[*] Notification on the current years beginning
[*] More twitch interaction on the  score screen
[*] Possibility to let mods intervene in the game through chat commands
[*] Change texts in the book
[*] Cloud-Error-Diagnosis
[*] Fix for overlapping settings menus
[/list]

Chat-Commands:
[list]
[*] !msg <message> (Writes a message ingame)
[*] !addBonusPackage (Adds a correct package to the game)
[*] !doPackage (Does a package for the player)
[*] !freeze (Stops all timers)
[*] !unfreeze (Starts all timers)
[*] !hurry (Tells the player to hurry)
[/list]
